laniard.definition:
n a cord with an attached hook that is used to fire certain types of cannon
n a cord worn around the neck to hold a knife or whistle
n (nautical) a line used for extending or fastening rigging on ships

laniary.definition: a of or relating to a pointed conical tooth
laniary.translation:
a. 适于扯裂东西的, 犬牙的
n. 犬牙

laniate.definition: v. t. To tear in pieces.

lanier.definition:
n. A thong of leather; a whip lash.
n. A strap used to fasten together parts of armor, to hold the
   shield by, and the like.
lanier.translation: n. [姓氏] 拉尼尔(美国诗人, 1842-1881)

laniers.definition:
plural of Lanier
n. A thong of leather; a whip lash.
n. A strap used to fasten together parts of armor, to hold the
   shield by, and the like.
laniers.translation: (Lanier 的复数) n.[姓氏] 拉尼尔(美国诗人, 1842-1881)

lanigan.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 拉尼根 Lennon的昵称; [地名] [加拿大] 拉尼根

lanigerous.translation: a. 有羊毛的, 羊毛似的

laniidae.translation: [网络] 伯劳科；佰劳属；佰劳科

laning.translation: 通道收缩, 形成狭窄通道

lanius excubitor.translation: [网络] 灰伯劳；二名法；大灰背伯劳
